title: Mystery schools aim to recover the lost knowledge of the gods on Mars

tellings.quote: one of the primary aspirations of the mystery schools is to recover the lost knowledge of the gods from Mars.

plain: The secret groups known as mystery schools, which pass down hidden spiritual knowledge, have one main goal: "to recover the lost knowledge of the gods from Mars," according to the filmmaker Tim Alberino. He gives this as his own reading. He draws on the writer David Flynn, on Cydonia, a region of Mars where some people see a face and pyramids in photos, and on Elon Musk's plans to go to Mars, which suggests he sees the push to reach Mars as tied to that old aim.
